FN-A5JE77S-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 33
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/06/2025
House Bill 33 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Youth Services
by an undetermined amount for fiscal years 2026 through 2030 dependent on the cost to: 1)
establish and operate a juvenile intervention pilot; 2) provide space and staffing in youth
detention facilities to comply with the provisions in the bill; and 3) provide annual reports to the
Governor and Legislature.
Further, this bill could increase obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency by agency
estimated minimum of $2 million per year for fiscal years 2026 through 2030 to provide staff
and develop and administer an intervention program as provided by this bill.
